name: mimo-computer-use
description: Cross-platform local computer-use tools for MiMo and OpenAI-compatible models in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Let MiMo and compatible models operate the desktop through local MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: MiMo Computer Use exposes a small set of local desktop automation tools to Codex, driven entirely by Node (nut.js for mouse/keyboard/screenshot) — no external binary or compiler toolchain. Vision models act on the screenshot; text-only models act on OCR'd text targets. An optional Electron overlay draws a glowing cursor on the real desktop.
